system.description:
Minotaur-headed lord of beasts and the endless maze. More dangerous when cornered.

  • Patron boon: You can't become lost, and you can always retrace any path you have walked.

Allegiance: Chaotic Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Baphomet in the World of Arneyan wiki.
